depiction.primary_object: rectangular briefcase or suitcase with top handle
depiction.composition: single object, front view, thick outline

ambiguity: Lacks interior lines or clasps, so it sits equally between an office briefcase and a travel suitcase; at very small sizes it could briefly look like a padlock or shopping bag.

reasoning: A plain rectangular case with a top handle is universally read as either a suitcase (luggage/packing) or a briefcase (work/career). It is great for tasks about physical bags, packing for trips, or general career/job-hunting headings, though a suitcase icon with wheels or a briefcase with clasps would distinguish the two senses more sharply.
